scope: Conservative named-ingredient and named-family blocking; not a complete drug interaction or cross-reactivity engine.
policy_notes: Family membership blocks the named family and its listed ingredients, as requested by the user. An ingredient-specific allergy conservatively blocks its listed family too.
Cephalosporin use in a person with a penicillin allergy is marked needs_review, not automatically labelled allergic or cleared.
A sulfonamide antibiotic allergy does not automatically imply allergy to every non-antibiotic sulfonamide.
Unknown products, combination products without separately identified ingredients, unknown allergy history and unspecified medication classes need review before recording medication use.
